Upon the triumph of that hard fanatic, the Brewer, who came to a timely end by the justice of high Heaven--my father, being disgusted with England as well as banished from her, and despoiled of all his property, took service on the Continent, and wandered there for many years, until the replacement of the throne.

arxiv-1805-06701.title: Quadratic Word Equations with Length Constraints, Counter Systems, and Presburger Arithmetic with Divisibility
arxiv-1805-06701.creator: Anthony W. Lin, Rupak Majumdar
arxiv-1805-06701.description: Abstract Word equations are a crucial element in the theoretical foundation of constraint solving over strings, which have received a lot of attention in recent years. A word equation relates two words over string variables and constants. Its solution amounts to a function mapping variables to constant strings that equate the left and right hand sides of the equation.

arxiv-2206-04660.title: Large deviation principle for random permutations
arxiv-2206-04660.creator: Jacopo Borga, Sayan Das, Sumit Mukherjee, Peter Winkler
arxiv-2206-04660.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jacopo Borga, Sayan Das, Sumit Mukherjee, Peter Winkler. We derive a large deviation principle for random permutations induced by probability measures of the unit square, called permutons . These permutations are called μ \mu - random permutations . We also introduce and study a new general class of models of random permutations, called Gibbs permutation models , which combines and generalizes μ \mu -random permutations and the celebrated Mallows model for permutations.

arxiv-2212-09084.title: Congruence subgroups and crystallographic quotients of small Coxeter groups
arxiv-2212-09084.creator: Pravin Kumar, Tushar Kanta Naik, Mahender Singh
arxiv-2212-09084.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Pravin Kumar, Tushar Kanta Naik, Mahender Singh. Small Coxeter groups are precisely the ones for which the Tits representation is integral, which makes the study of their congruence subgroups relevant. The symmetric group S n \mathchar 29011_{\mathchar 29038} has three natural extensions, namely, the braid group B n \mathchar 28994_{\mathchar 29038} , the twin group T n \mathchar 29012_{\mathchar 29038} and the triplet group L n \mathchar 29004_{\mathchar 29038} .

arxiv-2212-11845.title: p -forms from syzygies
arxiv-2212-11845.creator: Alan Muniz
arxiv-2212-11845.description: Abstract . These notes aim to develop a tool for constructing polynomial differential p p -forms vanishing on prescribed loci through syzygies of homogeneous ideals. Examples are provided through implementing this method in Macaulay2, particularly examples of instanton bundles of charges 4 4 and 5 5 on ℙ 3 {\mathbb{P}^{3}} that arise in this construction.

arxiv-2309-13468.title: Robert Millikan, Japanese Internment, and Eugenics
arxiv-2309-13468.creator: Thomas Hales
arxiv-2309-13468.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Thomas Hales. Millikan (1868–1953) was the second American to win the Nobel Prize in physics. At the peak of his influence, no scientist save Einstein was more admired by the American public. Millikan, the head of the California Institute of Technology (Caltech) during its first 24 years, oversaw its rapid growth into one of the leading scientific institutions of the world. However, in response to demands for social justice following the murder of George Floyd, Caltech launched an investigation into Millikan.

arxiv-2401-01200.description: Abstract Skin lesions are classified in benign or malignant. Among the malignant, melanoma is a very aggressive cancer and the major cause of deaths. So, early diagnosis of skin cancer is very desired. In the last few years, there is a growing interest in computer aided diagnostic (CAD) using most image and clinical data of the lesion.

arxiv-2406-01926.title: Explaining the possible 95 GeV excesses in the B-L symmetric SSM
arxiv-2406-01926.creator: Jin-Lei Yang 1,2,3 , Ming-Hui Guo 1,2 , Wen-Hui Zhang 1,2 , Hai-Bin Zhang 1,2,3 , Tai-Fu Feng 1,2,3
arxiv-2406-01926.description: Abstract Motivated by the excesses around 95 GeV observed in the diphoton and b ​ b ¯ b\bar{b} data, this study focuses on investigating these two excesses within the framework of the B − L B-L supersymmetric model (B-LSSM), due to the existence of two light Higgs bosons in the model.

arxiv-2510-11736.title: AI Agents for the Dhumbal Card Game: A Comparative Study
arxiv-2510-11736.creator: Sahaj Raj Malla
arxiv-2510-11736.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sahaj Raj Malla. This study evaluates Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents for Dhumbal, a culturally significant multiplayer card game with imperfect information, through a systematic comparison of rule-based, search-based, and learning-based strategies. We formalize Dhumbal’s mechanics and implement diverse agents, including heuristic approaches (Aggressive, Conservative, Balanced, Opportunistic), search-based methods such as Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) and Information Set Monte Carlo Tree Search (ISMCTS), and reinforcement learning approaches including Deep Q-Network (DQN) and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), and a random baseline.
